senses.en: unexpectedly; without someone being prepared
senses.zh: 出其不意地；猝不及防地

example.en: The question caught her unawares.
example.zh: 这个问题让她猝不及防。

senses.en: without realizing what one is doing; unintentionally

example.en: He was unawares drawn into the argument.
example.zh: 他不知不觉地被卷入了争论。

senses.en: (of rock) formed from cooled molten lava or magma

example.en: Granite is a common igneous rock found in mountains.
example.zh: 花岗岩是山中常见的一种火成岩。

senses.en: an old-fashioned person with outdated views or habits

example.en: Don't be such a fogy—try something new!
example.zh: 别这么老古板——试试新东西吧！

senses.en: (British spelling of fetus) an unborn baby at a later stage of development inside the womb

example.en: An ultrasound scan showed the foetus developing normally.
example.zh: 超声波检查显示胎儿发育正常。

senses.en: a strong alcoholic drink made from grain

example.en: He ordered a glass of whiskey at the bar.
example.zh: 他在吧台点了一杯威士忌。

senses.en: relating to a choir or chorus, or written for one
senses.zh: 合唱的；由合唱队演唱的

example.en: The concert opened with a choral performance.
example.zh: 音乐会以一场合唱表演开场。

senses.en: a worker who supervises other workers

example.en: The foreman told the crew to take a break.
example.zh: 工头让工人们休息一下。

senses.en: the leader of a jury

example.en: The foreman read the verdict aloud in court.
example.zh: 陪审团主席在法庭上大声宣读裁决。

senses.en: To clean or dry a surface by rubbing it with a cloth, paper, or your hand.
senses.zh: 用布、纸或手擦拭表面，使其清洁或干燥。

example.en: I wiped the kitchen table after dinner.
example.zh: 晚饭后我擦了厨房的桌子。

senses.en: To remove dirt or liquid by rubbing with a cloth or paper.
senses.zh: 用布或纸擦去污物或液体。

example.en: He wiped the spilled milk off the floor.
example.zh: 他擦掉了地板上的牛奶。

senses.en: An act of cleaning or rubbing a surface with a cloth or paper.
senses.zh: 用布或纸擦拭表面的动作。

example.en: She gave the table a quick wipe.
example.zh: 她快速擦了一下桌子。

senses.en: A cold dish of mixed vegetables or other ingredients, often served with dressing.
senses.zh: 色拉；沙拉：一种由混合蔬菜或其他食材制成的凉菜，通常配调味汁食用。

example.en: She made a fresh green salad for lunch.
example.zh: 她做了一份新鲜蔬菜色拉当午餐。

senses.en: relaxed and not formal or serious

example.en: He wore casual clothes to the party.
example.zh: 他穿着便装去参加聚会。

senses.en: happening by chance, without planning

example.en: It was a casual meeting; we hadn't arranged it in advance.
example.zh: 那是一次偶然的会面，我们并没有事先约好。

senses.en: not regular or permanent, especially of work

example.en: She works as a casual employee at the store.
example.zh: 她在这家商店做临时工。

senses.en: a person employed for temporary or irregular work

example.en: The restaurant hires casuals during the busy season.
example.zh: 这家餐厅在旺季雇用临时工。

senses.en: a particular area of a country or the world

example.en: This region is known for its tea plantations.
example.zh: 这个地区以茶园闻名。

senses.en: an administrative division of a country

example.en: The country is divided into several autonomous regions.
example.zh: 这个国家划分为几个自治区。

senses.en: a part of the body with a particular function or structure

example.en: The doctor examined the painful region of his back.
example.zh: 医生检查了他背部疼痛的部位。

senses.en: an object or device used for fighting or hunting

example.en: The museum displays ancient weapons from various cultures.
example.zh: 博物馆展出来自不同文化的古代武器。

senses.en: something used to gain an advantage in an argument or conflict
senses.zh: 手段；工具（用于争论或斗争）

example.en: Information can be a powerful weapon in public debate.
example.zh: 信息在公共辩论中可以成为有力的武器。

senses.en: to find the exact position of someone or something

example.en: We used the map to locate the nearest station.
example.zh: 我们用地图找到了最近的车站。

senses.en: to put or establish something in a particular place

example.en: The company plans to locate its new office near the airport.
example.zh: 公司计划把新办公室设在机场附近。

senses.en: a feeling of not being sure about something

example.en: There is some doubt about the cause of the delay.
example.zh: 延误的原因有些不确定。

senses.en: to feel unsure about something

example.en: She doubted her ability to finish the race.
example.zh: 她怀疑自己能否完成比赛。

senses.en: to think that something is unlikely

example.en: I doubt he will agree to the plan.
example.zh: 我怀疑他不会同意这个计划。

senses.en: a substance used to change the color of things such as fabric or hair

example.en: She bought some blue dye for the T-shirt.
example.zh: 她买了一些蓝色染料来染这件T恤。

senses.en: to change the color of something using a dye

example.en: He dyed his hair black last month.
example.zh: 他上个月把头发染成了黑色。

senses.en: not following accepted customs, rules, or standards
senses.zh: 非传统的；不落俗套的；非常规的

example.en: She took an unconventional path to success by starting her own business.
example.zh: 她通过创办自己的公司，走了一条非常规的成功之路。

senses.en: a scientist who studies stars, planets and other objects in space

example.en: The astronomer discovered a new planet orbiting a distant star.
example.zh: 这位天文学家发现了一颗围绕遥远恒星运行的新行星。

senses.en: the forces that produce movement, or the study of them in physics

example.en: The engineer studied the dynamics of the moving parts.
example.zh: 工程师研究了运动部件的动力学。

senses.en: the way forces or processes interact and change within a group or situation

example.en: The dynamics within the team changed after the new manager arrived.
example.zh: 新经理到来后，团队内部的动态发生了变化。

senses.en: a male given name

example.en: Stanley invited us to his birthday party.
example.zh: 斯坦利邀请我们参加他的生日聚会。

senses.en: a person who believes in a religion or idea

example.en: He is a firm believer in hard work.
example.zh: 他坚信努力工作的价值。

senses.en: a title of respect for a Christian clergyman, often used with the first name or initial

example.en: The Reverend Smith will lead the Sunday service.
example.zh: 史密斯牧师将主持周日礼拜。

senses.en: worthy of respect or reverence (formal or old-fashioned)

example.en: The poem praises the reverend old professor.
example.zh: 这首诗赞美了那位令人尊敬的老教授。

senses.en: careful with money and avoiding waste

example.en: Being thrifty helped her save money for a new bike.
example.zh: 节俭帮助她攒钱买了一辆新自行车。

senses.en: growing well and healthy

example.en: The farmer was pleased with the thrifty growth of his crops.
example.zh: 农夫对庄稼的茁壮生长很满意。

senses.en: coming immediately after in time or order

example.en: Let's take the next bus.
example.zh: 我们坐下一班车吧。

senses.en: nearest in space or position

example.en: He lives in the next house.
example.zh: 他住在隔壁那栋房子里。

senses.en: at the time or occasion immediately following

example.en: What are you doing next?
example.zh: 接下来你要做什么？

senses.en: the person or thing coming immediately after

example.en: You're next in the queue.
example.zh: 你是队伍中的下一个。

senses.en: very pleasing to look at or experience; lovely

example.en: The garden looks beautiful in spring.
example.zh: 这座花园春天看起来很美。

senses.en: very good; excellent (informal)

example.en: You did a beautiful job on the report.
example.zh: 你这份报告做得很出色。

senses.en: of the color of lemons or the sun

example.en: She wore a yellow dress to the party.
example.zh: 她穿了一条黄色的裙子去参加聚会。

senses.en: the color of lemons or the sun

example.en: Yellow is my favorite color.
example.zh: 黄色是我最喜欢的颜色。

senses.en: to become yellow, especially from age or lack of light

example.en: The old pages of the book have yellowed over time.
example.zh: 这本书的旧书页随着时间推移已经发黄了。

senses.en: costing little money; low in price

example.en: I found a cheap flight to Bangkok.
example.zh: 我找到了一张去曼谷的便宜机票。

senses.en: of low quality or seeming worthless

example.en: The handle felt cheap and broke after a week.
example.zh: 把手感觉很劣质，一周后就断了。

senses.en: tastelessly showy or of poor appearance

example.en: The hotel lobby was decorated in a cheap style.
example.zh: 酒店大堂的装修风格很俗气。

senses.en: pleased and happy

example.en: I'm glad to see you again.
example.zh: 很高兴再次见到你。

senses.en: an imaginary animal like a white horse with a single horn on its forehead

example.en: Children love stories about unicorns and rainbows.
example.zh: 孩子们喜欢关于独角兽和彩虹的故事。

senses.en: a strong but usually short-lived passion for someone or something

example.en: His infatuation with the band faded after a few months.
example.zh: 他对那个乐队的迷恋几个月后就淡了。

senses.en: more active than normal; unable to stay still

example.en: The hyperactive puppy ran around the yard all afternoon.
example.zh: 那只过度活跃的小狗整个下午都在院子里跑。

senses.en: a line or path with sharp alternating turns

example.en: The road down the mountain is full of zigzags.
example.zh: 下山路上有很多急转弯。

senses.en: shaped with sharp alternating turns

example.en: We followed a zigzag path up the hillside.
example.zh: 我们沿着一条之字形小路上山。

senses.en: to move along a zigzag path

example.en: The trail zigzags up the cliff.
example.zh: 小路呈之字形盘上悬崖。

senses.en: a spider's web, especially one that is old and dusty

example.en: Dusty cobwebs hung in the corners of the old attic.
example.zh: 旧阁楼的角落里挂着满是灰尘的蜘蛛网。

senses.en: to spoil the appearance of someone or something

example.en: The scar disfigured his face.
example.zh: 伤疤毁了他面容。

senses.en: the quality of flowing easily; the ability of a substance to flow

example.en: Water's fluidity makes it useful in industry.
example.zh: 水的流动性使它在工业中很有用。

senses.en: a state of constant change or instability

example.en: There is real fluidity in today's job market.
example.zh: 如今的就业市场变化不定。

senses.en: an open container in a stable from which horses or cattle eat

example.en: The farmer filled the manger with hay for the horses.
example.zh: 农夫在食槽里装满了干草喂马。

senses.en: the trough where the baby Jesus was laid in the Christmas story, as in a nativity scene

example.en: The children placed a small figure of Jesus in the manger of the nativity scene.
example.zh: 孩子们把一个小耶稣像放在圣诞场景的马槽里。

senses.en: too satisfied with oneself or the current situation, so not trying to improve

example.en: The team grew complacent after early success and lost the final matches.
example.zh: 球队在早先获胜后变得自满，输掉了后面的决赛。

senses.en: to make something ineffective or harmless

example.en: The team neutralised the threat before it spread.
example.zh: 团队在威胁扩散前将其消除了。

senses.en: (chemistry) to make a substance neutral, e.g. an acid with an alkali

example.en: The base neutralised the acid in the solution.
example.zh: 碱中和了溶液中的酸。

senses.en: harshly and severely critical

example.en: The critic wrote a scathing review of the new film.
example.zh: 这位影评人对这部新片写了一篇尖锐的批评。

senses.en: the act of becoming a king, queen, or ruler

example.en: The queen's accession was celebrated across the country.
example.zh: 女王的登基在全国受到庆祝。

senses.en: the act of joining a group or agreement

example.en: The country's accession to the treaty took two years.
example.zh: 该国加入该条约用了两年时间。

senses.en: to record a new item in a collection such as a library or museum

example.en: The library accessioned over a thousand new books this year.
example.zh: 图书馆今年登记了一千多本新书。

senses.en: used to talk about a possible or imagined result
senses.zh: 用于谈论可能或想象的结果

example.en: I would go if I had more time.
example.zh: 如果我有更多时间，我就会去。

senses.en: used for the future from a past point of view

example.en: She said she would call later.
example.zh: 她说她晚些时候会打电话。

senses.en: used to make a polite request or offer
senses.zh: 用于礼貌地请求或提议

example.en: Would you help me with this bag?
example.zh: 你能帮我拿一下这个包吗？

senses.en: used to describe a repeated action in the past
senses.zh: 用于描述过去反复发生的动作

example.en: When we were children, we would play outside every day.
example.zh: 我们小时候每天都会在外面玩。

senses.en: a person who lives near or next to you

example.en: Our neighbor helped us move the sofa.
example.zh: 我们的邻居帮我们搬了沙发。

senses.en: to be next to or near something

example.en: The new library neighbors the town hall.
example.zh: 新图书馆与市政厅相邻。

senses.en: a small container for drinking, often with a handle

example.en: She poured tea into a cup.
example.zh: 她把茶倒进杯子里。

senses.en: the amount that a cup holds, used especially in cooking

example.en: Add one cup of flour to the bowl.
example.zh: 往碗里加一杯面粉。

senses.en: a trophy shaped like a cup, given to the winner

example.en: The team lifted the cup after the final.
example.zh: 决赛后球队举起了奖杯。

senses.en: to curve your hands into a bowl shape, or hold something in your curved hands
senses.zh: 把手拢成杯状；用手捧住

example.en: He cupped his hands to catch the water.
example.zh: 他捧起双手接水。

senses.en: to work together with others on a project or goal

example.en: The two authors collaborated on a new novel.
example.zh: 这两位作者合著了一部新小说。

senses.en: to help an enemy that has occupied one's country

example.en: He was accused of collaborating with the enemy during the war.
example.zh: 他被指控在战争期间与敌人勾结。

senses.en: a hard white substance forming the tusks of elephants and walruses

example.en: The piano keys were once made of ivory.
example.zh: 钢琴琴键曾经是用象牙做的。

senses.en: a pale creamy white color

example.en: She chose an ivory wedding dress.
example.zh: 她选了一件乳白色的婚纱。

senses.en: made of ivory or of an ivory color

example.en: He bought an ivory chess set.
example.zh: 他买了一套象牙象棋。

senses.en: an adult male of domestic cattle; also the male of some other large animals, such as elephants or whales
senses.zh: 公牛；（鲸、象等某些大型动物的）雄兽

example.en: The bull charged across the field.
example.zh: 公牛冲过田野。

senses.en: a person who buys shares expecting prices to rise; the opposite of a bear

example.en: Bulls pushed the stock price higher this week.
example.zh: 看涨的投资者本周推高了股价。

senses.en: to push or force one's way roughly

example.en: He bulled his way through the crowded room.
example.zh: 他硬挤过拥挤的房间。

senses.en: to limit something within boundaries or restrict its extent

example.en: Please confine your comments to the topic of the meeting.
example.zh: 请把你的发言限制在会议主题之内。

senses.en: to keep someone from leaving a place, as by illness or imprisonment

example.en: The patient was confined to bed for two weeks after surgery.
example.zh: 手术后病人卧床两周不能下地。

senses.en: very beautiful or attractive
senses.zh: 极其漂亮的；华丽动人的

example.en: She looked gorgeous in her red dress.
example.zh: 她穿着红裙子，看起来美极了。

senses.en: a shelf for keeping books on

example.en: She put the novel back on the bookshelf after reading it.
example.zh: 她读完小说后把它放回了书架上。

senses.en: a regular oval shape or curved line

example.en: The planets move around the sun in ellipses.
example.zh: 行星围绕太阳沿椭圆轨道运行。

senses.en: moving in the opposite direction to the hands of a clock

example.en: Stir the batter in a counterclockwise direction.
example.zh: 以逆时针方向搅拌面糊。

senses.en: in the direction opposite to the hands of a clock

example.en: Turn the lid counterclockwise to open the jar.
example.zh: 逆时针转动盖子就能打开罐子。

senses.en: a person from Mongolia

example.en: A Mongolian greeted us warmly at the camp.
example.zh: 一位蒙古人在营地热情地迎接我们。

senses.en: the language spoken in Mongolia

example.en: She is learning Mongolian at university.
example.zh: 她在大学学习蒙古语。

senses.en: relating to Mongolia, its people, or its language
senses.zh: 蒙古的；蒙古人的；蒙古语的

example.en: The museum displays traditional Mongolian clothing.
example.zh: 博物馆陈列着传统的蒙古服装。

senses.en: a support for the head, especially on a car seat

example.en: Adjust the headrest so it supports the back of your head.
example.zh: 调整头枕，使其托住后脑勺。

senses.en: to make or become longer, especially by stretching

example.en: Regular stretching can elongate the muscles.
example.zh: 经常拉伸可以拉长肌肉。

senses.en: long and slender; having notably more length than width

example.en: The fish has an elongated body adapted for fast swimming.
example.zh: 这种鱼身体细长，适合快速游动。

senses.en: the state of being untrue; the quality of being false

example.en: Scientists demonstrated the falsity of the old theory.
example.zh: 科学家证明了旧理论的错误。

senses.en: a false statement; a lie

example.en: The article contained several falsities.
example.zh: 这篇文章包含多处不实之词。

senses.en: a calm and peaceful state; freedom from stress or worry

example.en: The quiet lake gave her a feeling of serenity.
example.zh: 宁静的湖面让她感到平静。

senses.en: funny, in an amusing or laughable way

example.en: He looked comical wearing a hat two sizes too big.
example.zh: 他戴着一顶大两号的帽子，样子十分滑稽。

senses.en: to hate something or someone very strongly

example.en: She detests being late for appointments.
example.zh: 她非常讨厌赴约迟到。

senses.en: the main subject a student studies at university

example.en: She is studying one of the most popular majors at the university.
example.zh: 她在大学里学的是最受欢迎的专业之一。

senses.en: the major leagues, the highest level of professional sport (especially baseball)
senses.zh: 职业体育大联盟（尤指棒球）

example.en: He was promoted to the majors after two seasons in the minor league.
example.zh: 在小联盟打了两个赛季后，他被提升到了大联盟。

senses.en: ideas produced by thinking

example.en: Please share your thoughts on the plan.
example.zh: 请谈谈你对这个计划的看法。

senses.en: a person's beliefs or opinions

example.en: His thoughts on education have changed over the years.
example.zh: 多年以来他对教育的看法有所改变。
